# Helpers

This directory contains the following Jeeliz helpers:

- [JeelizCanvas2DHelper.js](JeelizCanvas2DHelper.js): canvas rendering helper used by the sample filter.
- [HeadControls.js](HeadControls.js): head movement controls.
- [JeelizFaceCut.js](JeelizFaceCut.js): face cropping and color correction.
- [JeelizResizer.js](JeelizResizer.js): canvas and camera resolution selection.
- [JeelizThreeHelper.js](JeelizThreeHelper.js): Three.js scene integration.
- [addDragEventListener.js](addDragEventListener.js): draggable Three.js objects.

The shared [JeelizThreeHelper.js](../JeelizThreeHelper.js) is kept in the parent directory.
See [../LICENSE](../LICENSE) for the Jeeliz Apache-2.0 license terms.
